bio: This beautiful property is a little out of the way – on summer days, diners can enjoy sitting out on the terrace. The restaurant has been around for many years. In addition to cordial hosts and friendly service, the programme here includes regionally influenced cuisine, which you can choose to sample as a set menu or à la carte. The menu also features barbecued meat, such as rump steak, and classics like schnitzel and roast joint....
